reason: E2 directly shows that single Pd atoms on a high-entropy oxide increase oxygen vacancies and improve CO oxidation activity and stability, supporting the core premises. E1 discusses Pt on a high-entropy alloy, not an oxide, and addresses ORR rather than exhaust catalysis, so it provides only indirect, loosely related support for electronic structure effects.
